Subject: Employee screening and deprovisioning runbook — evidence request

Hi Jane / Daniel,

Per the SOC 2 scoping call last week, TrustAudit has requested a compact bundle showing our employee onboarding/offboarding controls for a sample of recent hires and leavers (Q3–Q4 2026). Can you confirm the exact evidence you need from our side? To help speed this up we're preparing:

- Background check summaries (redacted PII) for the 6 hires in scope
- Role-based training completion roster (security, acceptable use, data handling)
- Deprovisioning runbook and a sample of access revocation logs
- HR attestation statement for policy adherence

Target timeline from auditor: initial drop by Friday 12/18. Is that workable? If you need a narrow subset (e.g., only hires with elevated access), tell me and we'll produce that first.

I've attached a stub CSV and the current runbook for your review. Will follow up with a Drive folder link and signed attestations.

Thanks,

--
Monica Patel
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Jane Singh <jane.singh@trustaudit.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Employee screening and deprovisioning runbook — evidence request

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the clear summary — that is helpful. For the SOC 2 Type 2 sample we typically ask for the following artifacts per employee sampled:

1) Background check confirmation (redacted result + date)
2) Training completion record with timestamp and course IDs
3) IAM deprovisioning entry (timestamp + account ID) for any leavers in the sample
4) HR attestation on hiring policy adherence (signed PDF)

If you can provide the first two items for all six hires and the deprovisioning entry for the two leavers, we'll be able to start the control testing. Please include the Drive link and indicate which fields are redacted so our team can reconcile.

Deadline of 12/18 is fine — if you can provide something by EOD that gives us time to triage before the 20th. One ask: please include the date/time timezone for all logs (UTC preferred).

Regards,

Jane Singh
Senior Auditor, TrustAudit
Attachments: soc2_sample_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)
